server.composition: application-service query coordinator over existing owner repositories/providers
server.snapshot: single LLD-01 SQLite read transaction per response
server.timezone: stdlib zoneinfo using pinned IANA zone America/Guayaquil

client.rule: may retain the last successful response as disposable query presentation state; retained data must be marked stale after a failed refresh and cannot authorize commands

rationale: single read snapshot gives internally consistent cross-domain results
avoids invalidation races and schema/write amplification from a dashboard cache
bounded detail lists and owner-side indexed aggregates keep payload/query cost controlled
future materialization requires measured need and remains rebuildable/disposable
